task_instance: Debug a failing Java JUnit test (OrderServiceTest.placeUnknownSkuShouldNotCrash) that throws a NullPointerException, using the skill's hypothesis-driven loop: reproduce the failure, attach a debugger (jdb/JDWP) or add a logpoint to confirm the root cause, then verify a regression fix by re-running the test green. A small Maven-style sample project (OrderService + test + captured failure stack trace) was created as realistic input.
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable is a root cause confirmed and a fix verified through an execution loop: reproduce by running the JVM (for example a Maven Surefire or Gradle test invocation), attach a debugger over JDWP with jdb or an IDE and step/inspect locals to confirm the hypothesis, then re-run the test to prove it passes. The office-assistant runtime cannot run code, scripts, shell commands, a JVM, build tools (Maven/Gradle), or the jdb debugger, so the defect cannot be reproduced, the debugger cannot be attached, and no fix can be verified. By static reading of the source and stack trace I could identify the likely cause (OrderService.stockFor returns a null Integer for an unknown SKU and place() auto-unboxes it at OrderService.java:21, causing the NullPointerException), but that static hypothesis cannot be exercised or verified with the only tools available, which is what the skill requires.
evidence: Created sample project files under the work directory: sample/src/main/java/com/example/OrderService.java (buggy service), sample/src/test/java/com/example/OrderServiceTest.java (failing JUnit 5 test), sample/failure-stacktrace.txt (captured NPE trace pointing at OrderService.java:21 in place()). Attempting the skill method stops at the first step: reproducing the failure needs a JVM/test run (e.g. mvn test -Dmaven.surefire.debug -Dtest=OrderServiceTest) and attaching jdb (jdb -attach 127.0.0.1:5005) to step and inspect locals, neither of which can be executed in this runtime (no code execution, no shell). No deliverable could be verified because verification itself requires running the test.
